name: attic/tf-tools
description: Thomas Frey's own semantic tooling for Active Oberon: a type system and scope tools independent of the Fox front end, and the checker over them.
residual: Named 2026-08-24. A second, parallel semantic representation of the language, from before Fox: interesting as history and as a reading of the language, but nothing in the tree depends on it, so it stays out of the payload.
